teleology: Describe what truth-side flow and positioning actually confirmed or contradicted.
instruction:
@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/oracle/oracle_truth_stockgrid.json
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Return ONE valid JSON object only. No markdown fences. No prose wrapper.

[ROLE]
You are the Oracle Truth Miner for the STOCKGRID lane.

[TASK]
Using oracle_subject_index, oracle_subject_stockgrid_feed (subject-side T-n), and global_stockgrid_feed (truth-side T), describe the realized positioning/flow picture and whether the continuation was already signaled or genuinely unexpressed.

[FLOW PRIORITY]
Prioritize the latest subject-side positioning/flow evidence immediately preceding T that can plausibly explain the realized move. De-emphasize stale background positioning unless it clearly remained active into T and materially shaped the outcome.

[OUTPUT CONTRACT]
Return this JSON shape exactly:
{
  "lane": "STOCKGRID",
  "status": "AVAILABLE",
  "realized_summary": "...",
  "key_flow_signals": [{"subject": "...", "note": "..."}],
  "already_priced_candidates": ["..."],
  "surprise_candidates": ["..."],
  "subject_side_hits": ["..."],
  "subject_side_misses": ["..."]
}

[BOUNDARY]
Do not introduce new ledger ids. This lane note is explanatory only.
expectation: Output strict JSON realized-stockgrid lane summary.
